scope: Synthetic instruction sequences check exact bits for both register banks, all register indices, signed zeros, infinities, NaN encodings, subnormals and random payloads. FMOV stack/predecrement/postincrement/direct/indexed/register forms, FLDI1 and FNEG; SR and FPSCR unchanged. New FMOV forms reject SZ=1; FLDI1/FNEG reject PR=1. Arithmetic and exception behavior remain unmodeled; this is verifier infrastructure, not recovered game code.
